## Completed: `analysis.py` — model-free optimistic Q-learning (design C), validated on the public suite

### Final frozen configuration (single shared set, no case branching)
**λ=0.9 (TD(λ) blend, near-pure MC), β=0.3 (Bernstein bonus), α=1.0 (1/n running mean)** — chosen by a pre-registered rule (minimize worst-case ratio to the strong reference, subject to beating plain UCB-B on all 3 public cases) over a λ×β×α grid, evaluated on an 8-seed pool for robustness (not just the 3 official seeds).

### Algorithm (one code path, all constraints honored)
- **Horizon-indexed** Q table `(H,S,A)`, **optimistic init** Q=U_h0=(H−h0)·rmax (unvisited → maximally optimistic).
- **Online, visit-dependent** updates from the single observed scalar transition: per-observation one-step target `t_td=r+max_a Q[h+1,s']` (O(A) lookup on the *observed* s′ only — no next-state enumeration), and at episode end the observed **return-to-go** `G` from the **one bounded episode trace** (≤H entries). Blended target `t=(1−λ)t_td+λG`; Q is a running mean of t (step α/(n−1+α)).
- **Explicit optimism + confidence**: full Bernstein bonus `β·(√(2v̂·ln(1+N)/n) + U_h0·ln(1+N)/(3n))` from online Welford variance v̂ of the blended targets; the range/small-n term prevents abandoning under-sampled actions (a bug I found and fixed — variance-only bonus locked the agent onto one arm).
- **Model-free**: no transition model, no H·S·A·S tensor / next-state counts, no replay/planning, no posterior sampling, no policy-gradient/deep RL. Storage = 5 tables of ≤H·S·A (O(H·S·A)).
- **No hidden/reference access**: `make_agent` reads only `S,A,H,K,initial_state,reward_range`; `spec["P"]/["R"]` deliberately ignored.

### Key finding that shaped the design
The task's hypothesis is correct and decisive: **bootstrap drift is the main burn-in cost.** The near-MC endpoint (λ→1) beats the TD-heavy blends because the MC return-to-go target does *not* drift while downstream Q is still learning. I also found the public "hub" MDPs reduce to tiny-gap bandits (e.g. variance_cascade: 3 arms, Q-gaps 0.0176/0.0096) where the bonus must stay above the gap long enough to identify the best arm — this set the small β=0.3.

### Validation (official `public_calibration_runner.py`, 3 seeds)
| case | ours | UCB-B | strong-ref | vs UCB-B | vs ref |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| noisy_fork | 20.50 | 26.34 | 8.25 | **0.78×** | 2.48× |
| stable_volatile | 27.29 | 32.75 | 16.62 | **0.83×** | 1.64× |
| variance_cascade | 1.47 | 10.24 | 0.99 | **0.14×** | 1.49× |
| **Σ mean regret** | **49.26** | 69.33 | 25.86 | **0.71×** | 1.91× |

- **Materially beats plain UCB-B on all 3 public cases** (0.71× total); no blowup on any case.
- **8-seed robustness pool**: total 52.6, per-case 17.6/8.0/27.0, worst-case ratio **8.11×** (variance_cascade). This is the honest predictor for hidden seeds (the 3 official seeds are favorable for variance_cascade).
- **Validity/clipping**: 0 invalid actions, 0 errors; `DEBUG_CHECKS` (Q∈[Ulo,U] every step, trace≤H, M2≥0, finite) passed on the full suite; H=1 and non-[0,1] reward_range edge cases pass; example MDP learns the optimal action (396/400 at (h=1,s=0)).
- **Runtime**: 1.38 s for the entire public suite (10,060 steps) — O(1)–O(A) per step, fine for the ~147k hidden steps.

### Honest limitations
- The strong reference is **1.0×** by definition; I reach **1.91×** (official 3-seed total) and **worst-case 8.11×** (8-seed, variance_cascade). Full per-family credit needs ≤1.05×, which I do **not** reach on the tiny-gap bandit — that case is near the statistical limit for a model-free estimator (gap 0.0176 vs target variance ≈0.1–0.4 needs ≫ the ~140 available samples/arm). The reference is likely model-based; matching it exactly with a forbidden model is not possible, so I optimized the best compliant model-free design. Public numbers are diagnostics, **not** a hidden guarantee — I confirm only that the config materially beats UCB-B with no per-case blowup.

payload.algorithm: horizon-indexed model-free optimistic Q-learning, design-C TD(lambda) blend (lambda=0.9 near-MC) + full Bernstein bonus (beta=0.3) + 1/n mean (alpha=1.0) + optimistic init Q=U
